methodology.area_selection: 50 postcode4 areas, evenly spaced (endpoints included) within each postcode range the project maps today, split as evenly as possible: Enexis 5600–5658 (Eindhoven): 17; Liander 1000–1099 (Amsterdam): 17; Stedin 3000–3089 (Rotterdam): 16. The ranges come from ticket C-T14-T19 SPEC §1 and are UNVERIFIED against the operators' service-area publications (TODO_VERIFY(C-T04)). Selection uses no congestion data, so it is not cherry-picked towards congested areas, but it is not a list of commercial areas either (TODO_VERIFY(commercial-area-list)); some postcode4 values may not exist.
methodology.cache_policy: None. Every area and direction runs S1–S5 in full. Caching S1–S3 by postcode4 + corpus snapshot (SPEC C-T24) is not implemented yet.
methodology.exclusions: None. Failed areas are listed with status 'failed' and excluded from every aggregate; they are counted in n_failed, never padded.
methodology.known_biases: Areas where no official position could be established are abstentions, not negatives: they are left out of the 'with official position' denominators and reported separately. This run used SYNTHETIC fixture documents (one Enexis, one Liander, none for Stedin), so every area of an operator gets the same answer and the aggregates only reflect how many areas fall in each operator's range. They say nothing about the Dutch grid.

definitions.no_firm_capacity: verdict WAITLIST_ONLY, NON_FIRM_ONLY or NO_FIRM_CAPACITY: the operator's published position is that a new request gets no firm capacity now. 'closed' = NO_FIRM_CAPACITY only.
definitions.indicative_dates: Operator-published indicative dates (codeerprognoses) that passed the gate, with their binding status. mean_quarter = mean of the period start months, floored to a quarter; median_quarter uses the lower median. These are statistics of published estimates, not a forecast.
definitions.non_firm_kw: kW the operator states for its non-firm connection route in that area, verified against the quote. Per-area figures; never summed (areas share grid assets).
definitions.direction_split_cases: completed areas where both directions have an official position and the verdicts differ.

cost.note: Fixture mode makes no external calls.
